description: This file defines an abstract base class for model conditions used in a widget framework, including multiple concrete subclasses representing different types of conditions (e.g., AND, OR, NOT, compare, permission, regexp). It provides a factory for creating condition instances from XML elements, and implements evaluation logic for these conditions within a given context.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition
classes.description: Abstract base class for all model condition implementations. Provides common methods and inner classes for specific condition types.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.And
classes.description: Represents an 'and' condition combining multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.DefaultConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class to instantiate specific condition objects based on XML element node names.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfCompare
classes.description: Condition that performs comparison based on field value, operator, and type.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfCompareField
classes.description: Condition that compares two fields' values.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfEmpty
classes.description: Condition that checks if a field is empty.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfEntityPermission
classes.description: Checks if the user has permission on an entity.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfHasPermission
classes.description: Checks if the user has specific permission or action permission.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfRegexp
classes.description: Applies a regular expression match to a field's value.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfServicePermission
classes.description: Checks permission for a service call within the context.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.IfValidateMethod
classes.description: Invokes a validation method via reflection to validate a field.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.Not
classes.description: Represents a negation of a sub-condition.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.Or
classes.description: Represents an 'or' condition among multiple sub-conditions.

classes.name: AbstractModelCondition.Xor
classes.description: Represents an 'xor' condition among multiple sub-conditions.

methods.name: readSubConditions
methods.description: Reads sub-condition elements from the parent condition XML element and creates a list of ModelCondition instances.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the condition, using a visitor.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a given context map.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this condition object.
